messages.subject: Re: Thank you for your support
messages.text:
Hello,
 

 Yes, they are indeed two different models. The black neck warmer includes an adjustable drawstring feature and is priced at $39.99. The grey neck warmer, priced at $35.99, does not include this feature and offers a more streamlined design. This grey model is the first version we released and is offered at a lower price since it does not include a drawstring, but it still provides great warmth and comfort.
 

 According to your order L-43193, you ordered the first version at $35.99.
 

 I hope this clarifies the situation. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you need any further assistance.
 

 Kindly,
 __
 Catherine 
 

 Lasclay
